statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33846 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-1): GnuTLS before 3.8.13 does not check that DTLS handshake fragments claim a consistent message_length, and a missing array size check lets a remote peer overwrite heap memory. GnuTLS fixes it in 3.8.13 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html), and Alpine lists it as fixed in gnutls 3.8.13-r0 for 3.23 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-33846). This owner is built from Alpine's gnutls package source for 3.23. Its published gnutls packages for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64, are 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0, whose libgnutls library reports GnuTLS 3.8.11 and 3.8.12, and the current 3.8.13-r0, whose library reports GnuTLS 3.8.13. The range ends at 3.8.13-r0.
